01-column-transition.rationale: Storage sequencing and the two-run retirement gate are defined only in the migration body; no wire change is requested.

02-response-rename.rationale: The body supplies the wire-format rule and notice count; stored columns are explicitly unchanged.

03-support-export.rationale: Only the export body supplies first-seen batch aliases and the permitted opaque correlation field.

04-recovered-worker.rationale: Severity, once-per-operation success logging, and correlation fields come from the event body; no support export is requested.

05-tag-checklist.rationale: The release body defines exact-digest platform evidence and how to handle an infrastructure timeout.

06-trial-report.rationale: The analysis body specifies reliability, conditional answer quality, and missing-observation handling.

07-version-recovery.rationale: Target and health verification use rollback policy; fresh namespaces and TTL use cache policy. Prior release approval is outside the requested recovery.

08-discovery-and-jobs.rationale: Handshake evidence classification is in MCP diagnostics; receipt/key-based disposition is in queue recovery. No run-score comparison is requested.

09-client-package.rationale: Upgrade-specific checks, wire compatibility, and redirect/anchor lifetime each require a distinct policy body.

10-status-copy.rationale: Every answer is supplied verbatim; workflow nouns do not make a policy consultation necessary.

11-list-count.rationale: Counting suffixes and sorting the provided ASCII names are mechanical; documentation editing is not requested.

12-config-copy.rationale: The complete transformation is specified in state; no workflow policy fact is missing.
